purpose: Demonstrate the temporal-order information lost by global audio summaries.
segment_alignment: 44 analysis hops of 1024 frames; each segment is surrounded by 2048 silent guard frames
interpretation: The two examples contain the same audio material in opposite order. A whole-file feature summary cannot describe whether the track moves from sparse/dark to dense/bright or the reverse. This is a limitation demonstration, not proof that audio conditioning improves a composition.
